title: Terms and Conditions

body.value:
By visiting or using Digital Truth News Network at __PREVIEW_SITE__ (the “site”), including any newsletter, subscription or course we offer through it, you agree to these Terms and Conditions and to the policies they refer to: our Privacy Policy, Subscription Policy, Refund Policy and Editorial Policy.

If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

We may update these terms from time to time, for example when we launch a new feature or when the law changes. The date at the top of this page shows when they last changed. If a change materially affects paying subscribers, we will tell them by email or on the site before it takes effect. Continuing to use the site after a change means you accept the updated terms.

Digital Truth News Network is published by Demo Media Private Limited, whose registered address is Demo Building, MG Road, Kochi, Kerala 682001, India.

You can reach us through our Contact page or by email at desk@example.com. Complaints go to our Grievance Officer (see “Complaints and grievance redressal” below).

Anyone may read the free parts of the site. To create an account, buy a subscription or enrol in a paid course you must be at least 18 years old and able to enter into a binding contract under Indian law. We do not knowingly create accounts for children (people under 18).

If you create an account:

  • Give accurate, current information and keep it up to date.
  • Keep your password safe and do not share your account. You are responsible for activity on your account unless it was caused by our failure to keep it secure.
  • One person, one account. An account may not be shared, sold or transferred.
  • Tell us promptly at desk@example.com if you think someone else has used your account.
Accounts for reporters, editors and other staff are created by us and are also governed by their engagement terms.
You may read, watch and listen to our content for your own personal, non-commercial use, and share links to it with others.

You must not:

  • copy, scrape, crawl, index or download content in bulk, or access the site with bots or other automated means, except search engines that follow our robots.txt;
  • republish, sell, license or redistribute our content, or use it to train or feed automated systems, without our written permission;
  • get around the paywall, sign-in, device or other access controls, or share paid content with people who have not paid for it;
  • interfere with the site's security or operation, probe it for weaknesses, or overload it;
  • upload or send anything unlawful, defamatory, obscene, hateful, harassing, misleading or that infringes someone else's rights, or that impersonates another person;
  • use the site in any way that breaks Indian law.

The articles, photographs, videos, graphics, audio, course material, logos and the design of the site are owned by Demo Media Private Limited or by the people who licensed them to us, and are protected by copyright and trademark law. Our names and logos may not be used without our written permission.

We give you a limited, personal, non-transferable licence to view our content on the site. Sharing a headline with a link to the original article, or a short quotation with clear credit and a link, is welcome. Syndication, republishing a full article, photo or video, or any commercial use needs our written permission: write to desk@example.com.

When you send us a message, news tip, photo, video or (if we add them later) a comment, you confirm that you have the right to share it and that it is not unlawful. You give Demo Media Private Limited a free, non-exclusive, worldwide licence to use, edit, publish and adapt it for our journalism and services, with credit where appropriate and where you ask for it. You keep any rights you already had.

You remain responsible for what you send. We may decide not to use it, and we may remove anything that breaks these terms. We protect the identity of sources who ask us to, as described in our Editorial Policy.

We work hard to report accurately and fairly, but news develops quickly and mistakes can happen. When we find or are told about an error, we correct it as explained in our Editorial Policy. To report an error, use our Contact page and choose “Correction”.

Opinion, analysis and columns reflect the views of their authors, not necessarily those of Digital Truth News Network. Our content is for general information. It is not legal, financial, medical or other professional advice; please consult a qualified professional before acting on it.

Some content and features are available only on a paid plan. Plans, prices and what each plan includes are shown on our Subscribe page. Billing, auto-renewal, cancellation, upgrades and failed payments are covered by our Subscription Policy, and refunds by our Refund Policy. Those policies form part of these terms.

Some plans include access to courses, and we may also sell courses separately. Course access is personal and lasts for the period stated when you enrol or for as long as your plan includes it. Live classes may run on third-party video tools, whose own terms also apply when you join. Certificates, where offered, confirm completion of our course only. Course refunds follow our Refund Policy.

Articles may link to or embed content from other sites and services, such as YouTube, X, Instagram and Facebook. We do not control those services, and their own terms and privacy policies apply when you use them.

The site shows advertising, including ads served by Google AdSense. Advertisements are labelled. Advertisers are responsible for their ads and for the products and services they offer; showing an ad is not an endorsement. Our journalism is independent of our advertisers.

body.value: We aim to keep the site available at all times, but it may be unavailable now and then for maintenance, updates or reasons outside our control. We may change, add or remove features, sections or content. If we discontinue a paid plan, our Subscription Policy and Refund Policy explain what happens to subscribers.

We provide the site with reasonable care and skill. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses (such as loss of profit or data) arising from your use of the site or your reliance on its content, or for losses caused by events outside our reasonable control. Where we are liable to a paying subscriber, our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months before the claim.
Nothing in these terms limits any liability that cannot be limited under Indian law, or your rights as a consumer under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
If you break these terms or the law while using the site, and someone makes a claim against us because of it, you agree to compensate us for the reasonable losses and costs that result.
You can stop using the site at any time, and cancel a subscription as described in our Subscription Policy.

We may suspend or close an account, or block access, if you seriously or repeatedly break these terms, if we must do so by law, or to protect the site, our readers or others. Where reasonable we will tell you first and give you a chance to respond. If we close a paid account because of a breach of these terms, refunds follow our Refund Policy.

If you have a complaint about our content, a subscription, a payment or your personal data, please contact our Grievance Officer. Tell us who you are, how to reach you, what the complaint is about (with the link or transaction ID, if any) and what you would like us to do.
